title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-controls-util-reporting-v29
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: dedicated fleets can exhaust burst allocations during short spikes which causes elevated tail latency and customer impact. This PR tightens burst controls by using a token-bucket based admission at the fleet-level, exposes additional utilization and queueing metrics for SLO debugging, and surfaces a per-fleet burst-utilization report in the Console. Changes: 1) implement fleet_token_bucket admission controller with configurable refill and max_burst tokens and per-customer multipliers to support reserved capacity semantics; 2) expose new Prometheus metrics (redwood_dedicated_fleet_burst_tokens, redwood_dedicated_fleet_burst_consumption_total, redwood_dedicated_fleet_queueing_time_seconds_bucket) and wire them into existing metrics pipeline; 3) enrich utilization reporting pipeline to emit per-fleet 1m/5m/1h utilization windows and per-node queue depth histograms; 4) add Console route and API endpoint (/api/private/v1/fleets/{fleet_id}/burst-report) with pagination support for historical burst events; 5) add integration tests and canary job to exercise burst exhaustion scenarios; 6) docs: update dedicated autoscaling docs with configuration guidance and recommended defaults. Backwards compatibility: default burst behavior unchanged unless fleet config overrides token bucket settings. Checklist: commit tests, update docs, run perf canary, get SRE approval, update alerts. See linked Linear items for rollout plan.

ci_summary: All checks passed after fixes. Initial CI run: lint failed on docs formatting; subsequent runs: unit tests pass, integration canary pass, e2e flaky test fixed, prometheus exporter lint OK.
release_notes: Improved dedicated fleet burst controls and observability: token-bucket based admission with configurable burst/refill, new Prometheus metrics for burst tokens and queueing, per-fleet burst utilization reporting in Console, and recommended autoscaler defaults. Backwards compatible unless overridden.
deployment_notes: Rollout: 1) deploy autoscaler binary behind feature flag, 2) enable token_bucket at fleet-level via gradual rollout (10%->50%->100%) while monitoring redwood_dedicated_fleet_burst_consumption_total and tail latency, 3) update Console feature toggle and un-hide after verification. Recommended canary scenario included in ci/canaries/burst_canary.yml.
